winter.why: Word of a full granary has gone down the valley.

question.text: Bring every soul and the granary to the thaw.

chronicle.text: The other 84 nights of winter went by routine, the wall stood in turns. Joss and Yunus stood the most of them.
The thaw brought down the mill wall where it was climbed all winter. It cannot be stood next winter.
A hungry spring: the granary could not reach the harvest, and everyone went short until it came. Yunus gave away half of every bowl and grew thin.
Hugo and Jale came up the valley with their child Jonas, fleeing a raid, and asked to stay. They live behind the mill wall.
Kian took sling lessons from Tamar in the summer evenings.
A good harvest: the granary is well filled.
The autumn fair came to the meadow below the Gate.
You named Mara heir to the Gate, before Tamar had said a word.
A bigger bell was hung over the Gate.
Tamar died in the autumn, at 54, of a sickness that would not lift.
Winter came. Word of a full granary has gone down the valley. Bring every soul and the granary to the thaw.
